title: Remove the quarantine attribute from a file
summary: Extended attributes like 'com.apple.quarantine' can prevent files from opening or running. You can remove this specific attribute using the xattr command.

steps.explain: Delete the 'com.apple.quarantine' extended attribute from the specified file. This often resolves issues where macOS blocks a file from opening because it was downloaded from the internet.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the file you want to modify
